name: fig29_hawking_vs_page_reference
caption: The monotonic semiclassical reference S = k ln 2 (each emitted quantum is maximally entangled with a partner that stays out of reach) violates the dimension bound for k > N/2. The entropy of the radiation in any globally pure state of the finite system must turn over at or before the Page point, because S(R) = S(B) <= (N-k) ln 2.
